intent: A bounded preference between two distinct options. A selection is not a claim that either feature is already implemented.
steps: Choose an option or watch; review the result before deciding.

definition.title: Choose the next demo
definition.question: Which small feature should the next fictional demo explain first?

intent: Cards are proposals, not mutually exclusive answers. A distinct alternative or minority reason remains distinct even when one proposal has more support.
steps: Invite optional reasons and alternatives; preserve distinct minority views.

definition.title: Make the next demo easier to follow
definition.question: Which proposed change would help you follow a short live demo? Add a reason or a different idea if needed.
cards: Show one step at a time
Keep a visible example on screen

intent: An optional bounded recall question; decline or skip is valid. This is not a graded course, fluency judgment, or general model-quality score.
steps: Offer optional practice; skipping is always valid.

definition.title: Optional practice: check a revision
definition.question: The approved note says revision 8 is current. Which revision should this example use?
